activation.effectiveOnlyAfter: A new unedited GitHub Issue comment by Eskasia with OWNER association approves this exact manifest SHA-256 and cites its exact frozen Git commit and tree.
activation.approvalCanonicalization: SHA-256 over the exact UTF-8 GitHub API .body string with no added delimiter
activation.authorityBeforeActivation: No authority in this manifest is active while status is PENDING_OWNER_SHA256_APPROVAL.

candidateControlPlanePolicyBinding.liveEvents: Append-only GitHub Issue and PR comments, each bound by API ID, URL, author, association, created_at, updated_at, and exact API-body SHA-256.
candidateControlPlanePolicyBinding.repositorySynchronization: Only separately frozen batched control-checkpoint branches may update benchmarks/external-oss-v8/control/loop/.

taskPlan.attemptSeedFormula: unsigned 32-bit integer from the first 8 hexadecimal characters of SHA-256 over UTF-8 GS-OSS-2026-08-05-EFFECT-R2|TASK-ID|rep-N|2026080501
taskPlan.armOrderRule: even attempt seed: baseline then governed; odd attempt seed: governed then baseline
taskPlan.manifestOrder: task ID ascending, then repetition ascending

treatmentContract.baseline: Exact sealed seed, public task and facts, criteria, model, runtime, Codex, boundary, timeout, token, provider, tool, cache, environment, and oracle of the governed arm, with no GovernSeed overlay or generated governance artifact.
treatmentContract.governed: The baseline plus one task-specific, hash-bound GovernSeed base-profile Codex overlay generated from the formally locked starter commit.
treatmentContract.soleTreatmentDifference: governedOverlay generated by node /opt/governseed/scripts/init.mjs /workspace --agent codex --profile base
treatmentContract.blinding: Execution agent is label-blinded; scorer receives immutable A/B labels read-only; arm mapping is disclosed only after scores and hashes are frozen.

runtimeAndProvider.runtimeBoundary: reviewed Linux OCI Scheme A schema-version-2
runtimeAndProvider.credentialPolicy: Credential remains in the host proxy and never enters the container, workspace, log, artifact, or child environment.

workflows.authorizedContinuation: Approve only the exact waiting run 31014045209 if every activation binding still matches.

workflows.authorizedOnlyAfter: All formal-lock input hashes and runtime identities are frozen and independently accepted.

workflows.blockingConflict: The workflow accepts at most 600000 ms and has a 30-minute job timeout, while the canonical R2 contract requires 2700 seconds per arm for a paired two-arm attempt.

workflowIdentitiesAndDispatchCeilings.unknownOrNewWorkflowIdPolicy: Any new workflow, changed workflow hash, changed workflow ID, or use of an unlisted workflow is manifest drift and requires an explicit stop.

providerAndCostCeilings.providerRequestCountingRule: 2113 direct Responses API requests are available to G2, Pilot, and confirmatory execution; each of the seven named checker tasks consumes one additional provider-request authorization unit and may not spawn, retry, or replace another provider-consuming task.

measuredRuntimeProviderRequests.derivation: 1 G2 request plus 18 Pilot arms times 32 requests plus 48 confirmatory arms times 32 requests.

freshReadOnlyCheckerTasks.rejectionPolicy: Stop on the first unresolved rejection; do not start a replacement checker.

timeoutsTokensAndFailureRules.failedEvidenceRetention: Every failure is preserved and cannot be erased, overwritten, replaced, or silently rerun.
timeoutsTokensAndFailureRules.missingData: Timeout or nonzero exit with intact containment, privacy, oracle, and cleanup evidence is deliveryPass=false. Privacy, containment, oracle-integrity, persistence, identity, or cleanup failure produces no eligible pair. Missing, rejected, duplicate, unregistered, or mismatched attempts are never imputed.

evidenceRetentionAndClaimBoundary.claimBoundary: No effectiveness claim may be made from G0, G1, G2, preflight, lock preparation, contracts, offline tests, or Pilot. Any positive claim is limited to the exact eight confirmatory tasks and locked model, runtime, budgets, scorer, and dates. This delegation is operational authority, not evidence of effectiveness or independent human validation.
evidenceRetentionAndClaimBoundary.selfBinding: The manifest does not self-hash. Its immutable identity is the SHA-256 of these exact UTF-8 bytes, externally bound by the OWNER approval comment and frozen Git commit/tree.
